  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_Parent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify leave" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompany" name="Notify leave" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" name="Company information" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Parent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Parent" name="Parent planning starts"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FetchLeaveModels" name="Fetch leave models"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectLeaveModel" name="Select leave model"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectRelevantInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify split"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyCompany" name="Notify Company"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications done"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from company"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_LeavePeriodEnds" name="Leave period ends">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_LeavePeriodEnds"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Decide about extension"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend leave?" default="Flow_ExtensionNo"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LeaveEnded" name="Leave ended"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Parent" targetRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_FetchLeaveModels" targetRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel" targetRef="Task_CollectRelevantInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectRelevantInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="Task_SelectLeaveModel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${extendLeave == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_LeaveEnded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
